text: The Deseret Alphabet should be taught and we should pay attention to schooling our children in a way they can understand and learn that they may advance in the history of the world and in all the sciences of the day.
label: General Conference October
note: Brigham Young, “Texts for the Elders—The Perpetual Emigration Fund, Teaching Children at Home and School, the Rights of Women, the Temple Canals, and Marriage,” 1867 October General Conference, Monday Afternoon Session (1867-10-07). Pulpit Vault, edition of 14 November 2026 (commit d84338bd3e).
